description: This Java class defines a custom datatype for provider objects within the OpenMRS system. It extends a base metadata datatype class and provides a method for deserializing a Provider object from its UUID string representation.

classes.name: ProviderDatatype
classes.description: A custom data type class extending BaseMetadataDatatype for handling Provider objects with deserialization capability.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts a UUID string into a Provider object by querying the Provider service. Returns null if the input string is blank.
